name: LionDesk
description: LionDesk is Lone Wolf's legacy real-estate CRM for organizing contacts, nurturing leads and communicating through email, text, calls, video and automated follow-up.
agentUseSummary: LionDesk is visible as a legacy-product migration preview. Relay will not connect to the CRM, collect account credentials or move contact and communication data while Lone Wolf directs current users to migrate into Relationships without publishing a LionDesk production API contract.

capabilities.label: Review a bounded LionDesk migration path
capabilities.description: If Lone Wolf supplies a supported production contract, expose only exact-account, privacy-reviewed and typed contact migration status under explicit user control.

blocked.label: Capture LionDesk credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask a user to share a LionDesk login, session, integration key or any other undocumented credential.

blocked.label: Access LionDesk contacts or leads
blocked.description: Names, contact details, lead sources, notes, tasks, opportunities, timelines and other client records are unavailable.

blocked.label: Send communications or run automation
blocked.description: Email, text, calls, video messages, campaigns, reminders and automated lead follow-up are unavailable.

blocked.label: Migrate data or configure integrations
blocked.description: Relay will not migrate LionDesk contacts into Relationships or configure Zapier, lead routing or other third-party connections.

blocked.label: Run LionDesk actions before review
blocked.description: No LionDesk tool is callable until Lone Wolf confirms product support and publishes scoped authorization, exact tenant binding, lifecycle controls, API limits, audit identifiers and production distribution terms.

approvalProfiles.label: LionDesk legacy-product and migration review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable because LionDesk is a legacy CRM being migrated into Relationships and no current public LionDesk authorization contract is documented.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable while LionDesk lacks a current public production authorization contract.
No Hermes tools are callable while LionDesk lacks a current public production authorization contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Lone Wolf describes LionDesk as an acquired CRM spanning contact identity, lead nurturing, email, text, calls, video and automated follow-up, but its current product guidance directs LionDesk users to migrate contact data into the replacement Relationships product. Current official integration pages list curated Relationships partners and say custom API access is available for key Lone Wolf products, yet do not publish a LionDesk-specific self-service authorization, scoped API, tenant-binding, credential lifecycle, webhook or production distribution contract.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask Lone Wolf to confirm LionDesk's support horizon and provide a production integration contract or a Relationships migration API with delegated authorization, exact account claims, granular scopes, rotation and revocation, limits, audit identifiers, deletion handling, privacy terms and a staging tenant. Then implement only typed, purpose-limited migration status or contact reads with explicit user approval.

evidence.supports: Lone Wolf identifies LionDesk as its acquired CRM combining contact engagement through email, text, calls, video and AI-enabled lead follow-up.
Lone Wolf presents Relationships as its new contact-management product and directs current LionDesk users to migrate their contact data from LionDesk into Relationships.
The current Relationships integration catalog lists curated partners and routes custom-integration inquiries through Lone Wolf rather than documenting a LionDesk public API.
Lone Wolf records LionDesk among its 2020–2021 acquisitions and describes the 2024 Foundation launch as the current modular product platform.
